text: Apparel items can generally be returned within 14 days of delivery. The item must be unused and with original tags.
Footwear return window is strictly 10 days from the delivery date. Shoes must not show outdoor wear marks.
Electronics can be returned within 7 days. An unboxing video is mandatory for damaged electronics.
Home and furniture items have a 15-day return policy. Assembly defects must be reported within 48 hours.
Cash on Delivery (COD) refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item passes quality check. Bank account details must be provided via the tracking link.
Prepaid order refunds are reversed to the original payment source. This usually reflects within 3-5 business days.
Standard delivery SLA for metro cities is 2-4 business days. Non-metro deliveries take 5-7 business days.
In case of delayed delivery beyond the SLA, customers are eligible for a priority support escalation. Shipping charges, if any, will be refunded for delays over 3 days.
Reverse pickup is available for 95% of our serviceable pincodes. If your pincode is ineligible, you must self-ship the item.
If you receive a physically damaged product, a reverse pickup will be arranged free of cost. You must report this within 24 hours of delivery.
All returned products must be in their original condition. Missing accessories or tampered serial numbers will result in refund rejection.
Certain categories like innerwear, customized items, and unsealed beauty products are strictly non-returnable. Please check the product page badge before ordering.
